personalized.question: How does TravelMind personalize an itinerary?
personalized.answer: TravelMind combines your destination, dates, budget, and interests with place data to suggest a suitable itinerary. You can edit every activity before saving.

changePlan.question: Can I change a plan after creating it?
changePlan.answer: Yes. Open a saved trip and update its dates, places, or activities at any time. Your changes will be synchronized with the itinerary.

privacy.question: Is my trip data secure?
privacy.answer: Your account and trip information is protected by the system's security standards. TravelMind only uses data needed to operate and personalize your experience.

login.question: What should I do if I cannot sign in?
login.answer: Check your email and password, then refresh the page. If you still cannot get in, email our support team.

emergency.question: How can I get emergency support?
emergency.answer: Call +84 123 456 789 at any time. Non-urgent email requests receive a reply within two business hours.
